scientific_integrity: Universal proof supplied; independent finite signed-chain computations corroborate small cases. Classical nonequivariant wedge-of-spheres classification and Lucas multiplicity are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Rational dihedral character for cyclic Boolean cell complexes; does not classify integral group-ring modules, integral quotient torsion, or quotient fundamental groups. Older equivalent formulations not ruled out absolutely.
title: Dihedral homology characters of cyclic Boolean cell complexes
